name: Ava Crescentia
source:
The Student Council President and [url=/c22166]Kayto's[/url] longtime childhood friend. She is a high-performing individual with some empathy issues. The only enjoyment she gets out of life seems to be mentally outmaneuvering lesser minds, namely Kayto. Hardly ever smiles. Honestly, nobody knows why they're friends, but Kayto always remains doggedly loyal to her.

She appoints Kayto to be the club manager on the first day of school, setting into mtoion the chain of events which lead to Kayto's current predicament.
translation:
学生会会长，也是[url=/c22166]凯托[/url]相识多年的青梅竹马。她能力出众，却不太能体谅他人。她从生活中获得的唯一乐趣，似乎就是在智力上玩弄比自己低劣的人，也就是凯托。她几乎从不微笑。没人明白他们为何是朋友，但凯托始终忠心耿耿地跟着她。

她在开学第一天任命凯托为社团管理员，由此引发了一连串事件，最终让凯托陷入如今的困境。
